description: Workflow connector — runs a free-text prompt against an input payload (from an upstream workflow node OR a static form value) and emits structured output that downstream nodes can consume. Generic LLM transform / extractor / mapper. Unlike `aggregate` and `write-to-workspace` (which are runner-handled in-process), this primitive dispatches a real `prompt` subagent so the prompt actually runs against Claude. Skill validates args, builds the agent input, and dispatches the `prompt` subagent (the only writer to disk).

fields.label: Prompt (what to do with the input)
fields.placeholder: Read the index.md in the workflow input dir. Extract every Feature ID listed under the 'Refinement candidates' section. Output a JSON object: { "feature_ids": [<int>, ...] }.

fields.label: Input text (used only when no upstream node and no input file)
fields.placeholder: (leave empty when chained after another node)

Output schema (only with json — sample object or JSON Schema)

run.description: Run a free-text prompt against an input payload (upstream node OR static form text OR a file) and emit a single output file in text / md / json. Use to bridge two task-specific agents in a workflow — e.g. extract Feature IDs from a backlog-review report so a refinement agent can consume them.
